messages:
Maya: Hey folks, I'm clearing my desk and have a 27\" 1440p IPS monitor (Dell) + HDMI cable up for grabs. No stand tilt motor but works great with a riser. Pickup SF office, 6th floor bench. Pics: https://imgur.com/a/placeholder
Ethan: Interested. Is it VESA mountable?
Maya: Yep 100x100. I used a cheap arm for a year.
Priya: If Ethan passes, I can pick up Thursday morning.
Omar: I could swing by after standup and help carry if needed.
Maya: Will hold until Thu 3pm for whoever confirmed first. Please DM to claim.
Priya: DM sent. If anyone wants the HDMI cable separately lmk, otherwise it goes with the monitor.
Ethan: Thanks for clarifying re: VESA. Also, tiny scorch mark on the back from a soldering mishap? Not a big deal but FYI.
Maya: Haha yeah that was from a weekend hack, doesn't affect anything.
ops-bot: Reminder: please register items on the community pickup board and label with your name + date.
Omar: Also - Facilities says bench C near the windows is fine to leave it on. @facilities
Priya: I'll pick up at 9:30, Omar if you can help at 9:45 that'd be awesome.
Maya: Thanks all, monitor's yours Priya. Leaving it on bench C with a sticky note. :heart:
Ethan: Nice, glad it found a home.
Priya: Thanks Maya!
